Well as some of you know I asked who was playing. I added 2 people on steam and they both weren't playing, one tried to log in but I think they gave up when the initial server issues came up. Ubisoft Uplay went down but came back up around 1 am. I was able to get in and play with a friend who lives in the same town as I do.

We just got done about 45 minutes ago. Both level 8 and have the [](#s "first 3 wings open up and med wing upgraded 2 times (500 resource options)") He has an AMD setup with ATI card and I have Intel setup with Nvidia card. Both brand new rigs with comparable specs. I don't have all his details yet. I was able to play on Ultra/max settings. It didn't auto-detect 1 or two settings but auto detected ultra mode. Was very happy. I had one crash, but that was likely a driver issue. I was running the Feb 15 Nvidia drivers since the March 1st drivers impacted my Far Cry Primal FPS in a negative way (still playable, and didn't notice anything but I couldn't watch something on my second screen without it having an issue, re-installed old drivers to Feb 15 as rollback wasn't even an option in device manager).

Buddy is running Win 10, (he has 7 and advised him to roll back to it). He plans to when he gets his SSD (didn't know it made a huge difference, example he has hybrid drive, I have 2 SSD and one of them is the best on market from what I could tell, he was writing to at 25 Mbps on steam and I was hitting 51 to 52).

Issues I ran into was a single game crash. Buddy's rig had an issue where he was falling through the world. I am thinking it might have been an issue with his drivers or possible that the game world underneath, which is a DLC, was glitching causing people to fall through. He didn't update his drivers, but he restarted his rig and it stopped.

I didn't do the beta, he did. He bought the game based on his beta gameplay. I have to say this was the most fun I had playing co-op in a while. The boss fights have been unique. Won't give away any details. We died I think 2 times during a mission, that changed after we found some settings such as parkour mode and I changed my key to climb over stuff. Once I got a sniper rifle it was game over for the enemies, my friend was giving me crap for my aiming, at first, that quickly changed when I got my sniper rifle. Anyways. Those on the fence about this game really should give it a go, if your buddy has it see if they can let you play. You won't regret it.
